provenance.notes: Witness-backed upper bound only. Native validation ran 20,000,000 X trials and 20,000,000 Z trials; observed X=74, Z=72. REVISED 2026-09-18: Relation to existing entries: this is a distance revision of the board's own [[684,20,72]] entry, which it supersedes -- same code, same checks, same provenance and authorship, corrected distance only. A deep fresh-seed RIS ladder (bit-packed verify/gf2_fast, both Pauli sides searched jointly) exhibits a weight-48 Z-logical, so the previous witness-backed bound d <= 72 was overstated by 24 and the honest parameter set is [[684,20,48]], kd^2/n = 67.37 (previously 151.58). The weight-48 Z-side witness is carried in this entry. The X side is unchanged at 74: it is not refuted, and d is the minimum over the two sides. The earlier bound came from a different RIS implementation (`cpp_fast.css_ris_parallel`, 20,000 trials per side); the repository's own accelerator reaches the lighter logical at 8,000,000 trials, so the gap is a search-depth difference rather than a disagreement about the code. Distance remains a witness-backed upper bound, not an exact claim. No other board entry carries this (n, k, d, w); the change strictly tightens the entry and removes no other frontier point. Tightened 2026-09-23 by @vprusso: a GPU random-information-set audit (verify/ris_gpu.cu deep kernel: full kernel basis plus pair sums, pair depth 8, recover mode; 80,000,000 X and 80,000,000 Z trials in chunks with fresh seeds 3500 to 3507) exhibits a weight-40 X-type logical, so d <= 40 (X 74 -> 40). Per chunk: X 86 at 1,000,000 trials (seed 3500); Z 84 at 1,000,000 trials (seed 3501); X 44 at 29,126,225 trials (seed 3502); Z 72 at 29,065,548 trials (seed 3503); Z 76 at 30,378,639 trials (seed 3504); X 40 at 30,348,767 trials (seed 3505); Z 76 at 19,555,813 trials (seed 3506); X 42 at 19,525,008 trials (seed 3507). Every GPU operator was re-verified on the CPU with verify/gf2.py. Distance remains a witness-backed upper bound.
